## DSH Lite Exec v0.1.3

Optional plugin for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** providing four bounded shell and file inspection tools:

| Tool | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| `lite_exec` | Bounded shell execution with automatic spill files (`16 KiB` default preview, up to `16 MiB` per spill slot). Defaults to PowerShell under restricted Windows sessions and Git Bash under full access / POSIX platforms. |
| `lite_read` | Byte-window reader for large files, spill logs, and Electron ASAR entries. Supports `auto`, UTF-8, UTF-16LE/BE, GBK/CP936, binary hex preview (up to 512 B), and `ENOENT` filename suggestions. |
| `lite_grep` | Literal line search across files and explicit ASAR paths with up to 32 `include` globs, `ignoreCase`, bounded previews, and JSONL spill overflow (up to 5,000 matches). |
| `lite_stat` | Existence, size, modification time, and ASAR container metadata inspection. |

### Highlights in `0.1.3`
- **Broader DSH compatibility**: Declared `engines.dsh` range `>=0.2.2-rc.3 <1.0.0` (verified on `0.2.2-rc.3` and `0.2.2-rc.5`; requires Node.js `>=24`).
- **Hardened concurrent spill slot locking**: Replaced rename-based slot claiming with atomic `O_CREAT | O_EXCL` lock files (`.claim-slot-*`) shared across free and reused slots, plus dead-PID and empty crash-lock reclamation.
- **Faster & cleaner Windows private ACL handling**: Replaced `icacls` and PowerShell security cmdlets with zero-module pure .NET `DirectorySecurity` / `Directory::SetAccessControl` / `Directory::GetAccessControl` calls, eliminating Windows PowerShell 5.1 module-loading stalls; added a 30-second per-directory-identity DACL verification cache.
- **Improved Windows discovery & metadata**: Expanded Git Bash discovery (`PortableGit`, `SCOOP_GLOBAL`, `usr\bin`), and normalized `isAsar: false` for missing paths in `lite_stat`.

### Installation & Activation
1. Quit DSH Desktop and install the release tarball (also published on npm as [`dsh-lite-exec`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-lite-exec)):
   ```powershell
   dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-lite-exec-0.1.3.tgz --ignore-scripts
   ```
2. Enable the plugin in your Desktop profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, then reopen DSH Desktop and start a new session:
   ```yaml
   - id: dsh-lite-exec
     config:
       enabled: true
   ```

See [README.md](https://github.com/ClearMind-17/lite-exec/blob/main/README.md) and [README.zh.md](https://github.com/ClearMind-17/lite-exec/blob/main/README.zh.md) for full documentation.
